skill.name: skill-share
skill.description: Create structured Claude skills, package them for distribution, and share announcements in Slack through Rube.
skill.summary: Create, validate, package, and share team skills through Slack.
skill.author: ComposioHQ

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive on a Markdown example block in SKILL.md. The skill is prompt-only and describes skill creation, packaging, and Slack sharing through Rube, with no executable code in the scanned file.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 59 starts a Markdown fenced example, not Ruby backtick execution. Lines 60-66 contain prose describing expected workflow steps and no executable shell command.

content.value_statement: Teams need a repeatable way to create and distribute AI skills. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through skill setup, packaging, validation, and Slack sharing.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of a SKILL.md file with required metadata.
Describes standard skill folders for scripts, references, and assets.
Checks skill names and metadata before packaging.
Packages completed skill files for team distribution.
Posts skill announcements to Slack channels through Rube actions.
Shares skill names, descriptions, summaries, and file links.
limitations: Requires an authorized Slack workspace connection through Rube.
Requires write access to the target skill directory.
Does not include implementation scripts in the scanned file.
Cannot guarantee Slack delivery without valid channel access.

use_cases.title: Standardize Internal Skills
use_cases.description: Create consistent skill packages with expected metadata and folder structure.

use_cases.title: Announce New Team Tools
use_cases.description: Share new skills in Slack so teammates can discover and reuse them.

use_cases.title: Prepare Skills for Distribution
use_cases.description: Validate and package a skill before sending it to collaborators.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new skill named [skill-name] that helps with [task]. Include a clear description and required metadata.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a simple internal skill.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a Skill Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my skill draft for naming, metadata, folder structure, and missing requirements before I share it.

prompt_templates.title: Package and Announce a Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Package the completed skill named [skill-name] and prepare a Slack announcement for channel [channel-name].
prompt_templates.scenario: Distribute a finished skill to a team.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Reusable Skill Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a repeatable workflow for building, validating, packaging, and announcing skills for our team.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for PDF analysis and share it with the AI team.
output_examples.output: A new skill package is outlined with metadata, folders, validation steps, and a Slack announcement for the AI team.

output_examples.input: Check whether my skill is ready to package.
output_examples.output: The review highlights missing metadata, naming issues, required folders, and the next packaging step.

output_examples.input: Announce the new research-helper skill in Slack.
output_examples.output: A concise Slack message is prepared with the skill name, summary, purpose, and access link.

best_practices: Use clear hyphen-case skill names that describe the task.
Validate metadata before packaging or sharing the skill.
Send announcements only to relevant Slack channels.
anti_patterns: Do not create vague skill names that hide the purpose.
Do not share unfinished skills without validation.
Do not post skill announcements to unrelated Slack channels.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create Claude skill packages with metadata, folders, validation steps, and team sharing.

faq.question: Does it require Slack access?
faq.answer: Yes. Slack sharing requires a connected workspace through Rube and access to the target channel.

faq.question: Can it validate an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes checks for SKILL.md metadata, naming conventions, and required structure.

faq.question: Does it include executable scripts?
faq.answer: No. The scanned skill file is prompt-only and does not include implementation scripts.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare a skill name, a short description, a target directory, and a Slack channel if sharing is needed.
